description: tag() of a string is the identifier tag of that name, as a set of one tag, in a tag term and in a condition (engine §10).
grammar:
%rule text $w:word %conditions KOhA ⊆ $w.tags, $w.source-text.classify(migration-tags) = KOhA

%rule word $y:A :: $y.source-text.classify(migration-tags)
%classifier migration-tags "KOhA" ∈ KOhA
